item.text: The race is in the **harness's** `fuzzy.(*transport).AppendEntries`, not the audited package (raft frames appear only in the call stack). Let me record this.

Final turn complete. Report updated at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_14-01-25-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md).

This turn I ran the race detector against the audited code via the now-working fuzz harness (`go test -race -run '^TestRaft_NoIssueSanity$'`). It reported data races, but the racing read and write in every report are located in `github.com/hashicorp/raft/fuzzy.(*transport).AppendEntries` — the *harness's* own unlocked, v1.2.0-era transport. The audited `github.com/hashicorp/raft` functions (`replicateTo`, `replicate`, `startStopReplication`) appear only in the call stack, never as the racing access site. So this is a harness concurrency bug, not a defect in the audited package; it is recorded as such with the log at `audit-evidence/fuzzy_race_sanity.log`. A `-race` run of the audited package itself was not possible for the socket-dependent paths.

That is the last check I can add, and the audit is now genuinely exhausted within these permissions: the provenance question needs network (denied), transport tests need TCP (denied), and every other avenue — complete source review plus eight independent behavioral methods — has been exercised.

Final result:

- **Finding 1 (confirmed, low severity):** `testing.go`'s `cluster.EnsureSamePeers` freezes its reference peer set outside its retry loop, causing intermittent false `peer mismatch` failures in three shipped tests on a healthy cluster. Mechanism-verified and causally validated by a one-line fix (re-tested cases → 0/20).
- **No consensus-level defect**, across source review and eight independent methods (shipped suite, core-consensus batch, three custom invariant harnesses, the full `fuzzy` suite, and the race-detector pass), with all races attributable to harness code.
- **One open item, stated plainly:** whether that helper is the injected mutation or a latent upstream flake.
- **Scoped secondary observations:** the `fuzzy` submodule lacks a `RequestPreVote` case (needs `PreVoteDisabled` against raft ≥1.7), and its transport has a data race — both tooling issues, not raft correctness defects.

All artifacts are preserved under `work/` (report; 28 evidence logs/dumps; six `//go:build auditdiag` diagnostics; `repro/`, `_scratch_fixcheck/`, `_scratch_fuzzy/`), and the captured implementation was never modified.
